nodes.label: Client
nodes.description: Makes a request that needs some data.

nodes.label: API
nodes.description: Forwards every read straight through, no caching layer.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.description: Handles every single read directly, even for the same hot data over and over.

nodes.label: Client
nodes.description: Sends a read or write request.

nodes.label: API
nodes.description: Checks Redis first on reads; on writes, updates the database then invalidates the cache key.

nodes.label: Redis Cache
nodes.description: Serves hot reads directly. On a miss, falls through to the database and gets repopulated.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.description: Source of truth; only hit on a cache miss or a write.

nodes.label: Local Cache
nodes.description: In-process LRU cache on the API server itself, absorbing the very hottest small slice of traffic before any network hop.

nodes.label: Redis (jittered TTL)
nodes.description: Shared cache with randomized TTLs so keys populated together don't all expire in the same instant.

nodes.label: Request Coalescing
nodes.description: On a miss, only the first request queries the database; concurrent requests for the same key wait on that result instead of stampeding.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.description: Protected from stampedes and, for hot keys, only ever sees load from a single coalesced request at a time.
